_comment: Owners file of push PP-C (find a plant, know a plant; plus the palette-page fixes of the mock-up conformance report) of the Consortium v2 plan (knowledge/project/plant-palette-slices.md section 3, rewritten 2026-11-17 from .local/consortium/v2/ppc/design-check-c1.md, design-check-c2.md and conformance/report.md, citations at master f102922, corrected the same day by the amendment check .local/consortium/v2/ppc/amendment-check.md, 23 findings). Path -> stream per chunk: one owner per path per chunk; a path may change hands between chunks (store.ts main -> c2 -> pf; verdict-line.ts main -> c2 -> pf; kit/fit.tsx c2 -> pf; App.tsx c2 -> pf; PoolSlot.tsx c2 -> pf; views/palette/** main/c2 -> pf; views/kit/sheet.tsx and Sheets.tsx main -> c1; sqlite-source.ts and source.ts main -> c1; consortium-pp-b2.browser.test.mjs main -> c1 -> pf (c2's :441 range case handed to c1 through the coordinator); consortium-p5-s5c, -e6 browser and consortium-p5-seams main -> c2; consortium-pp-b1, -seams-layout and -seams-p2 browser main -> c1 -> pf, -seams-p5 browser main -> c1 (coordinator, 2026-11-17: c1's Find breaks their Add and Paste cases, pf's Place and palette rework the rest); the role files main -> c2 -> main). Patterns are repo-relative: '*' stays within a folder, '**' crosses folders. Chunks run in order; streams inside a chunk run in parallel (at most two building agents). Streams by feature: c1 Find (chunk 1), c2 One plant (chunk 1), pf the palette-page and Place fixes (chunk 2, after c1 and c2 merge; no early start). Commit 0 (chunk 0) deletes the Add sheet, list-query, jobFind and P5-14e first (owner rule 'Delete first'), writes the final role table (find matches views/find/** and views/Paste.tsx, so c1 needs no role change), keeps the reader accepting schema 3 and 4, and moves the 11 PP-C markers from parked to moved (plan-owners.test.mjs widened to PP-C). Chunk 3 main opens with 0b, the install of the published schema-4 export (real-data figures, weigh.json APG family cases, vectors), before the hand-offs. 'shared' lists the locale files: each listed stream adds keys only under its own prefix and changes or deletes only the keys its edits name; the merge agent joins the blocks. node scripts/plan/owners.mjs check <chunk> <stream> <base> --file scripts/plan/pp-c-owners.json fails a stream diff outside its rows. A file found needed mid-build is requested from the main agent, never taken. No backward compatibility work (owner, 2026-11-17): main deletes in commit 0 the beta tool's older-version paths and their keys consortium.share.outdated, consortium.share.pasted.outdated and consortium.start.oldSave (listed in main's edits); no stream adds alias or old-format handling.
step: consortium-v2 Plant palette redesign, push PP-C

shared.rule: the 11 flat locale files (pt in Brazilian Portuguese): main (chunk 0) changes the cross-locale words of report #18 (download note: 'light level and years', 'The palette shows in Canopi'), #28 (one German wording for the second-look mark) and #29 (nav.consortium 'Plant palette'), the invasive lines' 'checked against GRIIS', and deletes the keys only the deleted Add sheet read; c1 adds Find's words; c2 adds the Details, dispute, audience and confidence words (verdict, hole and year words only under consortium.line.) and deletes only the 22 keys read solely by *-marks.ts (its edits list them; the other range.*, estimate.from*, future.mark.* and future.long.* keys stay, PoolSlot, Weigh, future.tsx, pool.tsx and Details read them); pf's hand-off (commit 0 of chunk 2, coordinator) sets the light words (Full sun, Mostly sun, Part shade, Shade: consortium.palette.light_*, consortium.stratum.*, consortium.find.light*, consortium.print.col.layer, correction.fieldLayer), the hole title consortium.palette.holeTitle and the soft chip consortium.palette.invasiveCountries; then pf-a adds the Next step, holes, Find and hole-line words, pf-b the pictures, rows, Jobs, Warnings, Balance and toast words, pf-c the Place, location, country, loading and arrival words, each under its sub-prefixes (consortium.palette.next*/hole* a; chart*/plants*/job*/warnings*/balance* b; place*/location*/country*/load*/arrive* c); node scripts/plan/owners.mjs check fails any other key change against the chunk base; another key is requested from the main agent
